title: Frozen Yogurt Protein Bark
description: Greek yogurt spread thin, topped with berries and nuts, then frozen and snapped into bark-like pieces.
steps: Mix the yogurt with honey and spread thinly on a lined tray.
Scatter over the berries and almonds.
Freeze for at least 3 hours, then break into pieces.

source.label: Adapted from EatingWell Greek yogurt bowls

notes: A genuinely cold, crunchy snack for hot days — the thinner you spread it, the faster it freezes and the easier it snaps.
